description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small, senior team building autonomous AI agents for executive workflows. You will develop agent capabilities and evaluation systems that help ensure real-world tasks are completed reliably, with measurable improvements reaching users quickly.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build agents that complete delegated work end to end, without requiring users to check each step.

 - Define measurable success criteria and trusted ways to assess agent performance across tasks.

 - Develop and evaluate new agent capabilities before releasing them to users.

 - Investigate production failures and deliver durable fixes based on their underlying causes.

 - Build systems to detect known failure patterns and less predictable issues at scale, using tools such as Braintrust and Raindrop.

 - Improve agent recovery when tools or websites fail.

 - Create repeatable evaluation workflows that let engineers measure whether changes improve agent performance.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of data science or machine learning experience building evaluation systems, metrics, or product quality measurement.

 - Production-quality Python and SQL skills for analysis, large datasets, and automated pipelines.

 - Experience designing evaluation frameworks, representative datasets, meaningful metrics, and realistic end-to-end simulations.

 - A track record delivering production AI, ML, agent, or agent-evaluation systems for real users and measuring their impact.

 - Experience improving agent reliability, owning systems end to end, and using statistics and experiment design to evaluate changes.

 - Familiarity with post-training, fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning is useful.

 - Experience with Django, React, and TypeScript; the role also uses Python, SQL, Braintrust, and Raindrop.

 - Demonstrated progression and sustained experience in a role, with comfort working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in Palo Alto, California.
